title: A testRequest whose authorized_test_ref names a non-test/ ref is refused only as "malformed test request target", without saying why
outcome: A testRequest whose authorized_test_ref names a non-test/ ref is refused only as "malformed test request target", without saying why
acceptance: A testRequest refused because an authorized_test_ref's ref_name is not under refs/heads/test/ names the field and the rule in its refusal (for example that a landing-gate test ref must be refs/heads/test/<item>-<commit8>, and that author-test refs are evidence only), covered by a behavioural test of the refusal text's content.
Requests that are valid today are accepted unchanged.
